review_type: Repository-owner-commissioned AI-assisted Econometrica numerical-methods advisory review
recommendation: Reject in the present form and do not invite another ordinary revision of the cumulative manuscript. A new, substantially focused paper on witness-preserving compilation and acquisition-aware certification for constrained Lipschitz dynamic programs could merit evaluation, but R48 does not establish an Econometrica-level method-specific contribution for the broad Neural Bellman Operators program.
blocking_findings: The compiler is available to the identical native min-plus/Lipschitz-envelope algorithm and does not identify a neural-specific computational advantage.
Compiled witness is slower than uniform tensor FVI in 27 of 30 common successful prospective-target comparisons.
The target-one attainment advantage is cap- and threshold-sensitive because the FVI final bounds are approximately 1.0028 and 1.0131.
Direct policy-cost intervals favor FVI in six tasks, favor witness in none, and are unresolved in forty-two.
The direct cost study freezes R47 N=16 policies rather than the R48 first-crossing policies that generate the work-to-target claims.
The no-replacement conclusion depends on a theoretical fee 5.75 times the largest absolute confidence endpoint and lacks a break-even-fee analysis.
The error-driven FVI comparator realizes no nonuniform grids in 210 date models and does not close the adaptive-baseline question.
The dimension-three and dimension-four runs use unmatched caps and one observation per cell, so they are not common-accuracy scaling evidence.
The priced sensor rule minimizes a conservative bound, while the direct study does not evaluate the selected 12-16 bit policies or actual net information cost.
The cumulative 67-page article and broad retained application program remain disproportionate to the narrow compiler-and-certification result.
positive_findings: R48 is a canonical, immutable and cleanly rebuildable review-ready object.
The continuous compiler preserves the original feasible action witness and tie rule rather than only the value function.
Representation, fresh construction, certification and direct policy-value comparison are separated.
State acquisition, capacity repair and action quantization enter an explicit feasible-policy account.
The direct comparison estimates actual expected cost differences and retains unresolved action and sensor branches.
Strong adverse findings, failed targets, conventional wins and scope limitations are preserved.
Source freezing, record hashing, clean rebuild and historical preservation are unusually strong.

review_manifest.json.description: Pinned review scope, evidence identities, findings, limitations and change policy; deliberately omits its own identity

limitations: The reviewer did not rerun training, scientific simulation, LaTeX or timing services; new runs would create new observations.
The review verifies frozen records, hashes, aggregate arithmetic and the central compiler identity; it is not an independent proof of every inherited theorem.
Single-runner timings are descriptive and support no hardware-general performance inference.
No claim is made that tensor FVI dominates outside the declared R48 economies.
This advisory review is not an Econometric Society editorial decision.
